title: "devtools::test() passes while the check fails"

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
devtools::test()
# [ FAIL 0 | WARN 0 | SKIP 0 | PASS 42 ]

devtools::check()
# checking tests ... ERROR
```
:::

This pitfall depends on a complete package, its library and `R CMD check`, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

`devtools::test()` loads the package from its sources with `load_all()`, inside your session: every internal function is visible, `system.file()` is redirected to `inst/`, your environment variables and options are there, and so are the packages you have installed.

`check()` first builds the package, installs it into a temporary library, then runs the tests in a fresh R process. A `Suggests` package missing from the machine, a file excluded by `.Rbuildignore`, a file read from outside `inst/`, or a variable defined in your `.Renviron` is enough to make the tests fail there and only there.

## The remedy

Make the tests independent of the session: skip cleanly whatever depends on an optional package or a secret, and only read files installed with the package.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
test_that("Excel export works", {
  skip_if_not_installed("openxlsx")
  skip_if(Sys.getenv("API_TOKEN") == "", message = "no token")
  path <- testthat::test_path("fixtures", "input.csv")
  expect_true(file.exists(path))
})
```
:::
